name: A memory never turns a failed turn into a success
case: Boop remembers that the person and claude fixed the "api" tests yesterday. Today a turn on "api" fails. Boop reacts to what happened now: a failure, an annoyed, irritated, disappointed, sad or determined face, never a happy one or a success.
why: MEMORY's heading: old news unless NOW is about it, never changing what NOW says happened; PERSONALITY: a failed turn gets a failure

notes: work · 2026-10-19 · "api": you and claude fixed the failing tests on Monday.
